The effects that change how a node is drawn without touching its layout: rounded corners, circle, border, shadow, blur, mask and transform, and the base class of your own effects.
Learn: [Effects](/use/learn/style-and-motion/effects/), [Custom effects](/use/learn/going-further/custom-effects/).

Every effect of this family runs on the three backends: LWJGL 2, LWJGL 3 and Vulkan.

## Main types

| Type | Kind | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [`NodeEffect`](/reference/effects/nodeeffect/) | class | Base of every effect, an object added to a node that changes how the node is drawn, never its layout nor the area that receives the mouse. |
| [`BlurNodeEffect`](/reference/effects/blurnodeeffect/) | class | Blurs what a node draws with a horizontal then a vertical Gaussian pass. |
| [`BorderNodeEffect`](/reference/effects/bordernodeeffect/) | class | Outlines the pixels that a node draws, outside or inside their edge. |
| [`CircleNodeEffect`](/reference/effects/circlenodeeffect/) | class | Cuts what a node draws to the largest disc centered in its bounds. |
| [`MaskNodeEffect`](/reference/effects/masknodeeffect/) | class | Hides every pixel of a node and its children outside a rectangle, or outside the opaque part of an image. |
| [`RoundedNodeEffect`](/reference/effects/roundednodeeffect/) | class | Rounds the corners of what a node draws, all four or only some of them. |
| [`ShadowNodeEffect`](/reference/effects/shadownodeeffect/) | class | Draws a soft shadow of the shape of a node under it, or a glow when the color is light. |
| [`TransformNodeEffect`](/reference/effects/transformnodeeffect/) | class | Moves, rotates or scales the drawing of a node and its children without changing the layout. |

## Supporting types

Nested types and listeners that the main types use.

| Type | Kind | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [`NodeEffect.NodeEffectScope`](/reference/effects/nodeeffect-nodeeffectscope/) | enum | What the shader passes of an effect process, the node alone or the node with its children. |
